resolved.R15-1: Ordinary optional RCAS compile/layout/dispatch failures disable sharpening with one warning and visible unavailable status. Delivery and FG continue with zero applied sharpness. Wrong-device, invalid strength and device loss remain fatal; removal is checked before and after Apply. Shader compilation and layout preflight occur during initialization, not on slider use.
resolved.R15-2: Ordinary XeSS SR-only uses non-strict source-device acquisition. FSR FG startup and recreation retain strict same-adapter native ownership.
resolved.R15-3: Same-size FSR presenter resize accepts zero, current AMD buffer count, or original game buffer count without retiring owners.
resolved.R15-4: Successful INI decoding emits a notice when requested XeSS Auto FG is normalized off. Explicit FSR FG remains enabled. Canonical enum parsing stays strict: the review claim of case-insensitive decoding was not reproduced.
resolved.R15-5: Cached nativeOutput follows whether a usable ReShade module is present.
resolved.R15-6: RCAS tooltip explicitly describes after-upscaling ReShade effects and possible grain/noise sharpening. Execution order unchanged.

deferred.R15-7: Shader fusion and performance capture deferred; moving RCAS into XeSS encode would place it before After NR. No pipeline-order change or benchmark.

red: XeSS Auto requested-FG normalization lacked a notice.
Same-size original buffer count retired running owners.
Unusable ReShade addon API rejected real SR-only XeSS initialization.
green: Missing and broken shader cases preserve exact scene pixels/alpha and log one notice.
Unsupported BGRA8 preflight disables sharpening and preserves pixels/alpha.
Cross-device context rejected even after optional sharpening becomes unavailable.
Completed-frame and FG metadata contain actual zero sharpness after optional bypass.
Device-loss host failure never publishes an accepted FG source.
Counts 1 and 3 retain owners on same-size resize; minimize/restore regressions pass.
Auto notice and explicit FSR preservation pass.
Real official XeSS initializes with the unusable ReShade API fixture in SR-only mode; strict FSR ownership still rejects it.
regressions.review: Final independent read-only review found no remaining actionable issues after post-Apply device-loss check and applied-strength metadata coverage.

limits: New-build Skyrim sharpness and DXGI output-FPS visual confirmation remains pending.
GPU validation used RTX 4080 SUPER, XeSS and FSR3 FG; it does not qualify Intel FG, NVIDIA FG on XeSS, other GPUs or all ReShade versions.
Device removal is guarded in production and mocked at the host boundary; physical GPU device removal was not forced.
